mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently reduces equity discount rates, increasing present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor conditions, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate collapsing consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index above 220 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls above 130,000 consistently support consumer spending growth, driving corporate earnings expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 380,000 indicate robust consumer spending, boosting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days during strong demand regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 380,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) from prior month signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises from prior month.
